claims.claim_text: The indexed Lt Cmdr B N Deranian is a high-confidence match to OSS SO-Bari chief B. Nelson Deranian.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The uncommon surname and initials, naval-officer context, OSS service and 1944 SO-Bari leadership converge across the NARA index and an institutional scholarly study.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence; the evidence is unusually specific but the initial order and rank wording require Box 181 confirmation.
claims.temporal_assessment: The institutional source places Nelson B. Deranian at SO-Bari before 17 September 1944 and throughout the September planning period.
claims.match_notes: The index prints B N and Lt Cmdr; the study uses Nelson B. and a naval-lieutenant rendering. These differences are preserved rather than silently normalized.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Capt Antoine DeRecy is a high-confidence match to French officer Antoine Chalvet de Récy.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The distinctive name, captain rank, wartime intelligence mission and French military chronology align across the NARA index, official parliamentary biography and a contemporary newspaper account.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence; Box 181 remains necessary for a direct personnel-file bridge.
claims.temporal_assessment: The sources place his intelligence-gathering parachute mission in France in 1944.

claims.claim_text: Before his 1944 parachute intelligence mission, Antoine Chalvet de Récy served as aide-de-camp to French war minister André Diethelm and helped organize the Commandos de France.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official parliamentary biography and contemporary account give the same sequence: Diethelm aide-de-camp and Commandos de France work, followed by the 1944 parachute mission.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence match to the indexed captain; direct Box 181 confirmation remains pending.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded before the 1944 mission, but not proven to be the immediate predecessor to the indexed OSS relationship.
claims.match_notes: Published as a military/government assignment, not a civilian employer and not an asserted immediate pre-OSS affiliation.
